# RLM-RS Plugin Documentation

> Recursive Language Model integration for Claude Code

## Overview
RLM-RS is a Claude Code plugin that integrates the rlm-rs Rust CLI for processing documents that exceed typical context window limits using the Recursive Language Model (RLM) pattern from arXiv:2512.24601.

## Key Features
- Process documents up to 100x larger than the context window
- Multiple chunking strategies: fixed, semantic, parallel
- Hybrid semantic + BM25 search with Reciprocal Rank Fusion
- Pass-by-reference chunk retrieval via SQLite
- Distributed chunk analysis with sub-LLM agents
- Coherent synthesis from distributed findings

## Documentation Structure
- Getting Started: Installation and basic usage
- Concepts: Technical overview and architecture
- Reference: CLI command reference
- Skills: RLM workflow skill, chunking strategy guide
